==Russian==

===Alternative forms===
* {{alter|ru|дѣ́лать||ru-PRO}}

===Etymology===
{{inh+|ru|sla-pro|*dělati||to do}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{ru-IPA|де́лать}}
** {{audio|ru|Ru-делать.ogg}}
* {{IPA|ru|[ˈd͡zʲeɫat͡sʲ]|a=Belarus}} (''phonetic respelling'': дзе́лаць)
* {{IPA|ru|[ˈdʲɛɫɐtʲ]|a=Ukraine}}

===Verb===
{{ru-verb|де́лать|impf|pf=сде́лать|vn=де́лание}}

# to [[make]], to [[do]]
#* {{RQ:RSB|Mark|2|24|И фарисе́и сказа́ли Ему́: смотри́, что́ они́ де́лают в суббо́ту, чего́ не должно́ '''де́лать'''?|t=And the Pharisees said to him, “Look, why '''are''' they '''doing''' what is unlawful on the Sabbath?”}}

==Russian==

===Etymology===
{{inh+|ru|sla-pro|*orbotati}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{ru-IPA|рабо́тать}}
** {{audio|ru|Ru-работать.ogg}}
* {{IPA|ru|[raˈbotətʲ]|a=Southern Russia}}
* {{IPA|ru|[raˈbotat͡sʲ]|a=Belarus}} (''phonetic respelling'': рабо́таць)
* {{IPA|ru|[rɐˈbɔtɐtʲ]|a=Ukraine}}

===Verb===
{{ru-verb|рабо́тать|impf|pf=порабо́тать|vn=рабо́тание<q:nomen actionis, occasional>}}

# to [[work]] {{+obj|ru|:над(ins)<on a task> + :на(acc)<for someone> + ins<as an occupation or role>|ins<with a tool or device>}}
# to [[function]]
# to [[labor]], to [[toil]]
# to be open {{gloss|for business}}
